name: luna-pool-orchestrator
description: Cost-first engineering orchestration with bounded Luna workers, an adaptive reporting leader, and token-free live status.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate cheaply with visible Leader progress.
interface.longDescription: Heliolune runs four function-affine Luna/max workers and one adaptive Luna/high operations leader behind a blocking MCP boundary. Sol retains planning, architecture, risk, review, and final acceptance while an inline MCP App or automatic Windows fallback shows token-free Leader status.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $luna-pool-orchestrator for one bounded task: start it with visible Leader status, await once without polling, then return a compact result.
